# Arusha Wildlife Safaris

> Tanzania safari and Kilimanjaro trekking operator based in Arusha, running the
> northern circuit, Great Migration departures and Zanzibar extensions since
> 2014. Private trips only, maximum 6 guests per vehicle, with park fees
> and full board included in every published price.

Trips run from USD 2,150 to USD 4,120 per person sharing. The company owns its
vehicles and employs its guides on annual salary rather than per trip. Contact:
book@arushawildlifesafaris.com, WhatsApp +255 700 000 000, Njiro Road, Arusha, Tanzania.

## Safari itineraries

- [Northern Serengeti river crossings](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/safaris/northern-serengeti-river-crossings): 6 days in Serengeti, from USD 3,450 per person. Six days across the Serengeti's northern corridor, timed to the Mara River crossings.
- [Classic northern circuit](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/safaris/classic-northern-circuit): 7 days in Tarangire, Ngorongoro, Serengeti, from USD 2,890 per person. Seven days through Tarangire, the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater. Big Five in one loop.
- [Machame route, Kilimanjaro](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/safaris/machame-route-kilimanjaro): 7 days in Kilimanjaro, from USD 2,150 per person. Seven days to Uhuru Peak at 5,895 m, with an extra acclimatisation night at Karanga.
- [Serengeti balloon and plains](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/safaris/serengeti-balloon-and-plains): 4 days in Serengeti, from USD 2,680 per person. Four days in the central Serengeti with a sunrise balloon flight over the Seronera valley.
- [Safari and Zanzibar](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/safaris/safari-and-zanzibar): 10 days in Serengeti and Zanzibar, from USD 4,120 per person. Five days on the northern circuit, then four nights on the north-east coast of Zanzibar.
- [Calving season, Ndutu](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/safaris/calving-season-ndutu): 5 days in Ndutu and southern Serengeti, from USD 3,120 per person. Five days on the short-grass plains in February, when roughly 8,000 calves are born each day.

## Destinations

- [Serengeti National Park](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/destinations/serengeti): Northern circuit. Best time: June to October, and February for calving.
- [Ngorongoro Crater](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/destinations/ngorongoro): Conservation area. Best time: Year-round; drier June to October.
- [Tarangire National Park](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/destinations/tarangire): Northern circuit. Best time: July to October.
- [Mount Kilimanjaro](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/destinations/kilimanjaro): Kilimanjaro region. Best time: January to March, June to October.
- [Zanzibar](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/destinations/zanzibar): Indian Ocean. Best time: June to October, December to February.
- [Ndutu and the southern plains](https://www.arushawildlifesafaris.com/destinations/ndutu): Conservation area. Best time: January to March.

## Kilimanjaro routes

- Machame: 6 nights, 62 km, 89% summit rate on our own departures, from USD 2,150. First-time climbers with six spare days who want the best success-to-cost ratio.
- Lemosho: 7 nights, 70 km, 92% summit rate on our own departures, from USD 2,680. Climbers who can spare eight days and want the widest acclimatisation margin.
- Marangu: 5 nights, 64 km, 68% summit rate on our own departures, from USD 1,890. Climbers who need a bed and a roof, or are travelling in the wettest months.
- Rongai: 6 nights, 73 km, 81% summit rate on our own departures, from USD 2,340. Climbing in the shoulder months, or wanting the fewest people on the trail.
